### Observability Architecture: RED Metrics & Google SRE 4 Golden Signals
This dashboard unifies the **RED Method** (*Rate, Errors, Duration*) and Google SRE **4 Golden Signals** (*Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation*) across the entire stack.
- **HTTP Telemetry**: Captured host-wide without code changes via **Grafana Beyla eBPF** (`http_server_request_duration_seconds_*`).
- **System & Process Saturation**: Exported by **Node Exporter** (host CPU, Memory, Disk, Network) and **Process Exporter** (`namedprocess_*`).
- **Application Signals**: Deep subsystem Golden Signals for **LiteLLM**, **OpenSRE**, and **VictoriaMetrics**.

panels.title: Executive Summary — RED & Golden Signals at a Glance
HTTP Request Rate (Traffic / Rate)
panels.description: Total inbound HTTP request rate across all monitored services via Beyla eBPF.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Error Rate (Errors)
panels.description: HTTP 5xx server errors per second across selected services.

panels.title: HTTP Error Percentage (Errors)
panels.description: Percentage of requests resulting in 5xx server errors.

panels.title: p95 Latency (Latency / Duration)
panels.description: 95th percentile HTTP response duration across selected services.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Host CPU Saturation (Saturation)
panels.description: Host CPU busy percentage (excluding idle).

panels.title: Host Memory Saturation (Saturation)
panels.description: Host memory utilization percentage (100% - available%).

panels.title: HTTP Requests / sec by Service
panels.description: Throughput per service monitored by Beyla eBPF.

panels.title: HTTP Requests / sec by Status Code Class
panels.description: Traffic breakdown across HTTP 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, and 5xx response classes.

panels.title: Top HTTP Routes by Inbound Traffic
panels.description: Top 10 highest-throughput HTTP endpoints.

panels.title: Host Network Throughput (RX / TX Traffic)
panels.description: Network interface bandwidth consumption (bytes per second).

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Server Errors by Service
panels.description: Rate of critical 5xx server failures per service.

panels.title: HTTP 4xx Client Errors by Service
panels.description: Rate of client errors (400, 401, 403, 404, 429) per service.

panels.title: Error Rate Percentage (%) by Service
panels.description: 5xx failure percentage relative to total request rate per service.

panels.title: Service Error Budget & Health Table
panels.description: Real-time summary of request rate and error status per service.

panels.title: Overall Latency Percentiles (p50, p90, p95, p99)
panels.description: Latency percentile distribution across all monitored HTTP traffic.

panels.title: p95 Latency by Service
panels.description: 95th percentile response duration broken down per service.

panels.title: Mean Latency by Service
panels.description: Average HTTP request duration calculated from Beyla sum and count counters.

panels.title: Database & Backend Client Operation Duration (p95)
panels.description: Database and backend client call duration via Beyla instrumentation following OpenTelemetry db.client.operation.duration semantic conventions.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, db_system_name, db_system) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Process CPU Saturation (%) by Service
panels.description: CPU utilization percentage by process group from Process Exporter.

panels.title: Process Memory Saturation (Resident Memory)
panels.description: Resident set size (RSS) memory consumption by process group.

panels.title: Host CPU Saturation by Mode
panels.description: Breakdown of CPU time across user, system, iowait, and steal modes.

panels.title: Host Memory Saturation Breakdown
panels.description: Host memory breakdown into used, cached, buffers, and free.

panels.title: File Descriptor Saturation (% of Limit)
panels.description: Worst file descriptor utilization ratio per process group.

panels.title: Application Golden Signals — AI & Observability Subsystems
LiteLLM — Gateway Throughput & Errors
panels.description: LiteLLM gateway success vs failure rates.

panels.title: LiteLLM — p95 Latency & In-Flight Concurrency
panels.description: LiteLLM end-to-end request duration and in-flight request saturation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(litellm_request_total_latency_metric_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: OpenSRE Agent — Traffic & Active Investigations
panels.description: OpenSRE AI Agent request rate and in-flight autonomous investigations.

panels.title: VictoriaMetrics — Ingestion & Query Rates
panels.description: Ingestion throughput, query execution rate, and internal errors.
